Solopreneurs.Title: Conversational System for Ideation
Solopreneurs.Description: Develop a chat-like interface where solopreneurs can interact with an AI system. The AI will prompt users with questions to gather their views, opinions, and knowledge about their business or expertise.

Solopreneurs.Title: AI Script Generation
Solopreneurs.Description: Implement an AI system that uses gathered information to generate 90-second scripts, including scene descriptions. Ensure the scripts have a proper hook, arc, and finish to maximize engagement on social media platforms.

Solopreneurs.Title: Campaign Management
Solopreneurs.Description: Create a feature that allows solopreneurs to create and manage campaigns. Each campaign will have a series of generated scripts that users can review and edit before finalizing.

Solopreneurs.Title: Content Extraction and Formatting
Solopreneurs.Description: Develop functionality to allow users to export generated scripts into structured document formats (e.g., Word or PDF) for review and feedback.

Solopreneurs.Title: Multi-language Support
Solopreneurs.Description: Ensure the platform supports multiple languages based on user input. The AI should automatically detect the language of the user's input and generate scripts in that language.

Solopreneurs.Title: API Key Management
Solopreneurs.Description: Implement a feature that allows users to input their own OpenAI API key to use the AI functionalities, ensuring the system is tied to the user's own account.

Solopreneurs.Title: Local Data Storage
Solopreneurs.Description: Store all user data, including inputs and generated scripts, locally in JSON files within a specified storage directory. Ensure efficient management of local storage for quick access and retrieval of data.

Solopreneurs.Title: Script Review and Editing
Solopreneurs.Description: Provide a user-friendly interface for solopreneurs to review and edit AI-generated scripts before finalizing them for use.

Solopreneurs.Title: User Interface Design
Solopreneurs.Description: Design a simple, full-screen interface with a dashboard that includes buttons for creating new campaigns and viewing existing ones. The conversational system should resemble a chat window for intuitive user interaction.

Solopreneurs.Title: Data Backup Responsibility
Solopreneurs.Description: Inform users about their responsibility for backing up their data manually, as the platform will not include built-in backup or data recovery features.
